Qz.bar_b_note: The glowing orb and light shards give the moment some spectacle, but the tiny result text under full persistent HUD cards on a flat, featureless green grass carpet sinks it next to Palworld's dense meadows.

Dn.bar_b_note: Tidewake's cyan sky and pale dunes carry the chapter mood, but the translucent ghosted companion and evenly scattered grey blob rocks on bare sand sink the finish.

Xx.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra's white fleece, dark horns and scale over the trainer match the owner style bar, though side B's distorted faint frames would break that read in play.

Dc.bar_b_note: The tight top-down strike and absorb shots show only an orb on uniform grass with the companion cropped to a brown smear, so neither world nor staging reads at Palworld finish.

Za.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder villager with clear face and eyes and an earthy green-brown outfit that fits the meadows palette, slightly more cartoon than the naturalistic creature bar.

Sr.bar_b_note: The meadow with its rounded hill landmark and blue sky is on palette, but the grass is a uniform carpet with no groves or edges and the readout still sits on the target, so it reads well below Palworld density.

Kv.bar_b_note: The armoured boar has bulk and scale over the trainer, but blocky tile-like plates, floating faint poses and a faint-end material that goes almost pure black keep it below the owner style bar.

Hh.bar_b_note: A dim brown forest floor with no visible purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings, a barely visible player creature, and in side A canopy and trunks blacking out whole frames.

top_changes.change: Give every world-anchored catch readout (capture chance, breakout/caught text) a deep blue-grey translucent plate at a larger size, offset it off the target and grass, and dim or hide the persistent creature cards and command bar during the catch result; keep the catch camera at the wide aim framing with the companion and trainer in shot instead of cutting to a tight top-down view.

Stormwood fight readability: fade or cull trunks and canopy between camera and fighters, frame so the player's creature is always visible, replace the flat magenta telegraph rings with real-object effects (lightning, debris) with impacts, and bring in the purple storm sky and white-violet lightning light so the event belongs to the chapter.

Fix faint states: ground the faint mid/end poses (no hovering bodies above their shadows), stop the faint-end material on the armoured boar going black, and repair the distorted, flattened Stormcapra faint frames.
